refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-024/r3_gr9_link.cob (--std 85, run dir r3_gr9_link-002) took the arm the reader did not: data-name-1 in the LINKAGE SECTION of a called program (SR4 admits Working-Storage or Linkage), the FD in the subprogram, the item the caller's. WRITE R FROM SRC with LL=07: 'W FS=00 LL=07', caller 'AFTER-WRITE ML=07' (WRITE ... FROM does not alter it); successful READ sets it from the record: 'R FS=00 LL=07 R=[ABCDEFG             ]'; an at-end READ after MOVE 44: 'EOF2 10', 'E LL=44', caller 'AFTER-FAILREAD ML=44'. Class c side effect: the first draft used WRITE R FROM "ABCDEFGHIJ" and --std 85 refused it 'COBOL0871: FROM literal-1 requires COBOL-2002', the 1985 format's identifier-only FROM.
